title: Uniform complex border-rank bounds from all-cut Schmidt ranks

comparators.scope: 19 explicit PaperStatements contracts, including all seven nonexempt original numbered results, actual all-cut Bhat bound, original anchored representation, and four own Section 5.2 packages.
Same19-target suite with a deliberate first-target type mismatch.
Same19-target suite with a deliberate unauthorized proof dependency.

main_results.scope: For nonzero finite complex tensors of order at least two, the maximum Schmidt rank gives the explicit border-rank bound, including the rank-one product branch.
For nonzero tensors of order at least two and D >= 1, all nontrivial cut ranks <= D imply membership in the projective Segre secant of index Bhat D.
For nonzero tensors of order at least two with maximum Schmidt rank >= 2, constructs the original anchor sets, support coordinates and coefficient reconstruction without assuming a presentation.
The dimension of the actual iterated partial-derivative space of the set-multilinear tensor polynomial equals the sum of all cut Schmidt ranks.
